title: Lenticular grid
description: Black-and-white interlaced artwork flips through narrow red-edged ribs.
useCase: A tactile switching texture for print-led identities and collectible digital editions.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. A screen-space print illusion, not a physical lenticular display. Fine ribs may alias at small scales.
look: Full-bleed cream and near-black graphic of a sine wave and circle, sliced into narrow vertical ribs with thin red edges and cylindrical shading.
motion: Each rib's soft threshold between a wave image and a circle image sweeps on an ~18 s sine, flipping the picture back and forth; the slider offsets the view.
adapt: The effect is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `p.x*46.0` sets rib density, `view` the sweep speed and slider range, `ridge` the red edge, and `a` and `b` are the two images to replace. Keep the WebGL lifecycle and reduced-motion branch.
